plain_text: Amazon needs a value that this listing does not send.
seller_action: Add the missing value to the product, then send the listing again.

plain_text: Amazon found text, a logo, a graphic or a watermark on the main image, which this product type does not allow.
seller_action: Replace the main image with a plain product photo on a white background, then send the listing again.

plain_text: Amazon needs a value that this listing does not send.
seller_action: Add the missing value to the product, then send the listing again.

plain_text: Amazon does not accept one of the values in this listing.
seller_action: Pick a value Amazon allows for that detail, then send the listing again.

plain_text: Amazon does not accept one of the images in this listing.
seller_action: Replace the image with one that meets Amazon's image rules, then send the listing again.

plain_text: Amazon needs an image that this listing does not have.
seller_action: Add the required image, then send the listing again.

plain_text: Amazon needs your account to be approved before it can list this product.
seller_action: Apply for approval for this brand or category in Amazon Seller Central, then send the listing again.

plain_text: Amazon does not accept the product type this listing was sent with.
seller_action: Choose the category that matches the product, then regenerate the listing.

plain_text: Amazon does not accept the product category (browse node) this listing was sent with.
seller_action: Choose the category that matches the product, then regenerate the listing.

plain_text: Amazon already links this barcode to a different product.
seller_action: Check the barcode on the product. If it is right, keep your GS1 certificate ready for Amazon support.

plain_text: Amazon matched this listing to a product that does not fit its details.
seller_action: Check the barcode and the product details, then send the listing again.

plain_text: Amazon says this barcode is not registered to the listing's brand.
seller_action: Check the barcode. If it is right, give Amazon proof that the brand owns it.

plain_text: Amazon says this barcode is restricted or not registered with GS1.
seller_action: Check the barcode. If you own the product, send Amazon your GS1 certificate.

plain_text: Amazon does not let the barcode of an existing item change.
seller_action: Send the original barcode for this SKU, or ask Amazon support to change it.

plain_text: Amazon has a different barcode on record for this SKU.
seller_action: Send the original barcode for this SKU, or ask Amazon support to change it.

plain_text: Amazon says this product already exists in your account under another SKU.
seller_action: Kuinn's team checks the existing listing; a SKU cannot be renamed on Amazon.

plain_text: Amazon does not let a SKU change from its original value.
seller_action: Kuinn's team checks the original SKU; a SKU cannot be renamed on Amazon.

plain_text: Amazon does not let this attribute change once the item exists.
seller_action: Kuinn keeps Amazon's original value; edit it only through Amazon support.

plain_text: Amazon has not approved your account to use this brand name.
seller_action: Enrol the brand in Amazon Brand Registry, or apply to use the brand name through the link in Amazon's message in Seller Central, then send the listing again.

plain_text: Amazon does not yet let your account create new products for this brand.
seller_action: Check the brand name is spelled exactly as registered, link your Brand Registry and selling accounts, or apply through the link in Amazon's message, then send the listing again.

plain_text: Amazon matched this listing's barcode to existing products whose details differ from this listing.
seller_action: Check the barcode is right for this product. If it is and Amazon's product details are wrong, ask Amazon support to correct them.

plain_text: Amazon could not match this listing to a product it knows, and needs more details to create a new one.
seller_action: Check the barcode, add any detail Amazon names in its message, then send the listing again.

plain_text: Amazon could not match this listing to a product it knows and needs more details to create one. Amazon also says this when a GTIN exemption is claimed for a brand or category it has not approved.
seller_action: Check the product's barcode. If you chose the GTIN exemption, check that Amazon approved it for this exact brand name and category, or add the barcode instead. Add any detail Amazon names in its message, then send the listing again.

seller_action: Add the missing value Amazon names in its message, then send the listing again.

plain_text: Amazon does not accept one of the values in this listing: it is not on Amazon's list of allowed values for that detail.
seller_action: Pick a value Amazon allows for that detail, then send the listing again.

plain_text: Amazon needs a barcode for this product, or a GTIN exemption that Amazon approved for its brand and category.
seller_action: Add the barcode from the pack on the product's Barcode. If the product has none, get a GTIN exemption from Amazon for this brand and category, choose the exemption on the product's Barcode, then send the listing again.

seller_action: Check the product's barcode against the pack and fix it. If it is right, send Amazon your GS1 certificate, then send the listing again.

seller_action: Copy the barcode again from the pack into the product's Barcode, then send the listing again.
